Offline.offline: You’re offline. The articles kept on this device can still be read; Archive, Favorite and Delete wait for a connection.
Offline.empty: No articles are kept on this device. While online, open an article and choose Keep offline.
Offline.notKept: This article isn’t kept on this device, so it needs a connection.
Offline.partial: This summary covers only the beginning of the article.
Offline.keepFailed: Couldn’t keep it on this device. Try again once you’re online.

settings.heading: Offline reading
settings.intro: In an article, Keep offline stores its clean copy and summary in this browser, to read without a connection. Pictures aren’t kept, and signing out removes the articles.
settings.count: {count, plural, =0 {No articles are kept on this device.} one {One article is kept on this device, about {size}.} other {# articles are kept on this device, about {size}.}}
settings.removeAllConfirm: Remove every article kept on this device?
settings.safari: On {iphone} and {ipad}, {safari} deletes them after 7 days without a visit, unless {app} is on the Home Screen: Share → Add to Home Screen.
